bugs_found: fx_convert rejects same-currency conversions unless an explicit rate exists; this can break zero-risk identity conversions
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure during credit can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, allowing float/type errors and Receipt.amount type drift
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for fractional inputs
money results are not quantized to currency scale, so sub-cent balances/fees/payments can leak into production
